# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the mandatory rules in [docs/00-ssot/ai-agent-guidelines.md](../docs/00-ssot/ai-agent-guidelines.md).

Key points: Angular 19 standalone + signals (no BaseComponent, no Material); page text only in `src/app/content/`; styling with the compact UI kit classes and `--ui-*` tokens (no hex); keep routes and slugs stable; update docs with every behavior change.
